sections.title: Order charges overview
sections.content:
## Overview

The system calculates order charges automatically based on the configured charge structure, the freight rate for the route, the customer information, and any surcharges that have been incurred.

sections.title: Accessing and selecting an order
sections.content:
### Step 1

Go to the **Freight charges** > **Order charges** menu.

![Freight charges menu with Order charges open](/uploads/9621850578178612589db970.png)

The system shows the freight charge management list.

![Order charge management list](/uploads/ab80cac67dbb709c4e07aa16.png)

### Step 2

Select the order you want to calculate charges for to open its details screen.

![Selecting an order to calculate charges for from the list](/uploads/68867b01e22b2b526cd93ebc.png)

The system opens the charge details page for the selected order.

![Charge details screen for the selected order](/uploads/a794eb6957a1dbf92383a940.png)

sections.title: Conditions before calculating
sections.content:
Before calculating charges, check the following:

- The correct charge structure is selected.
- A [freight rate](/d/freight-rates#freight-rates-overview) matching the route and the customer exists.
- All [surcharges](/d/surcharges#how-surcharges-are-applied) have been confirmed.

![Where to check the charge structure before calculating](/uploads/6ebf2089ba300160fce26043.png)

> **Note:** For a route or a customer that appears for the first time, check and update the rate before calculating. Once the data is configured, the system remembers it and applies it the next time.

sections.title: Loading the data
sections.content:
### Step 1

Click **Load data** to load the items used for the calculation.

![Load data button on the order charge screen](/uploads/52a4d93a959953b875f4433b.png)

### Step 2

Once the data has loaded, check the item lines in the **Order charges** section.

![Order charge items after the data has loaded](/uploads/cb7c531dcfdca84d13e65313.png)

sections.title: Calculating
sections.content:
### Step 1

Click **Calculate**.

![Calculate button on the order charge sheet](/uploads/32f19408d2c688af5bb98679.png)

### Step 2

Select **OK** in the confirmation dialog to start the calculation.

![Confirmation dialog for calculating order charges](/uploads/d0e7bb9b5638875394079ce0.png)

When the calculation succeeds, the system applies the charge structure, takes the matching rate, adds the confirmed surcharges, and calculates the total customer freight amount together with the related costs.

![Successful order charge calculation result](/uploads/d53dd8cda1761837c5f8be19.png)

sections.title: Confirming the charges
sections.content:
### Step 1

After reviewing the result, click **Confirm**.

![Confirm button for order charges](/uploads/5b4b6856d6e759ca01e925a7.png)

### Step 2

The system records the order charges as confirmed.

![Order charges confirmed](/uploads/5b1a41c8f0ff18c61f0f8f20.png)
